game.title: Minnesota Vikings at New Orleans Saints

lede: New Orleans Saints carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#21 in EPA per play), while Minnesota Vikings owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#1 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it New Orleans Saints -2.6 with a fair total of 40.7 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is New Orleans Saints pass offence vs Minnesota Vikings pass defence, which sits −0.276 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
